title: timeline.add_marker
description: Add a marker at sequence time 'time'. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.add_marker; 'color' follows OPP/1 section 5 Color (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) instead of the legacy named palette (green/red/...).

sequence.description: Opaque entity id (OPP/1 section 5 EntityId): footage / sequence / track / clip / node id. Never parse its format; ids are invalidated on project reload. Defaults to the active sequence.

time.description: Marker position on the sequence timeline.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

name.description: Marker name; the engine derives a default when omitted (OPP/1 marks it optional).

color.description: Marker color as OPP/1 section 5 Color: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
